items.text: UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Tshono ebantwaneni bakoIsrayeli uthi kibo: Nxa lifika elizweni lezindawo zenu zokuhlala engizalinika lona,

Niyakunikela kuJehova ngomnikelo womlilo, umnikelo wokushiswa noma umnikelo wokugcwalisa isithembiso noma umnikelo wesihle noma emikhosini yenu, ukunikela ngephunga elimnandi kuJehova, owezinkomo noma owezinkomo noma owezilwane umhlambi:
Oletha umnikelo wakhe kuJehova uyakuletha umnikelo womlilo wesahlulo seshumi sempuphu ecolekileyo exovwe nokwesine kwehini lamafutha.
Ingxenye yesine yehini lewayini njengomnikelo wokuphuzwayo uyakuyilungisa kanye nomnikelo wokushiswa noma umhlatshelo ngewundlu elilodwa.
Noma ngenqama kumelwe ulungisele umnikelo wokusanhlamvu izingxenye ezimbili eshumini zikafulawa oxutywe nengxenye yesithathu yehini lamafutha.
Njalo uzalungisa ingxenye yesithathu yehini lewayini njengomnikelo wokunathwayo, libe yiphunga elimnandi eNkosini.
Uma ulungisa ijongosi libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa noma libe ngumhlatshelo wesithembiso noma iminikelo yokubonga kuJehova,
Kumelwe alethe umnikelo womlilo wezingxenye ezintathu zokweshumi zempuphu ecolekileyo exovwe nengxenye yehini lamafutha kanye nenkunzi.
Kumelwe ulethe inxenye yehini lewayini libe ngumnikelo wokuphuzwayo, libe ngumnikelo womlilo wephunga elimnandi kuJehova.
Kumelwe kwenziwe kanjalo ngenkunzi eyodwa noma ngenqama eyodwa noma ngewundlu noma izinyane lembuzi.
Ngokwesibalo eniyakusilungisa, nikwenze njalo kuzo yileso naleso ngokwesibalo sazo.
Wonke umuntu ozelwe ezweni kumelwe enze lezi zinto ngale ndlela ngokunikela ngomnikelo womlilo onephunga elimnandi kuJehova.
“ ‘Uma umfokazi egogobele kini, noma ophakathi kwenu ezizukulwaneni zenu, eletha umnikelo womlilo omnandi kuJehova, njengoba wenza, kanjalo Naye uzokwenza.
Kumelwe kube yisimiso kini, ebandleni nakumfokazi ogogobeleyo kini, kube yisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu; njengoba unjalo wena, umfokazi makabe njalo phambi kukaJehova.
Kuyosebenza umthetho owodwa nendlela eyodwa kini nakumfokazi ogogobeleyo kini.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Khuluma kubantwana bakoIsrayeli uthi kubo: Nxa lifika elizweni engizaliletha kulo,
Khona-ke kumelwe, uma nidla isinkwa sezwe, ninikele ngomnikelo wokuphakanyiswa kuJehova.
Kumelwe nilethe iqebelengwane lokuqala lenhlama yenu libe ngumnikelo wokuphakanyiswa; njengalokhu nenza umnikelo wokuphakanyiswa wesibuya, niyakuwuphakamisa kanjalo.
Kolibo lwenhlama yenu niyakunikela ngomnikelo wokuphakanyiswa kuJehova ezizukulwaneni zenu.
Uma nidukile, aniyigcinanga yonke le miyalo uJehova ayikhuluma kuMose,
Konke uJehova aniyala ngakho ngesandla sikaMose, kusukela osukwini uJehova ayala ngalo uMose nasezizukulwaneni zenu;

Kuyakuthi, uma kwenziwa ngokungazi ibandla lingazi, ibandla lonke liyakulungiselela ijongosi elilodwa libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, libe yiphunga elimnandi kuJehova kanye nomnikelo walo wokudla nomnikelo walo wokuphuzwayo, ngokomthetho, nenqama eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wesono.

Umpristi kumelwe ayenzele isihlawulelo yonke inhlangano yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, futhi bayothethelelwa; ngoba kungukungazi; bayakunikela ngomhlatshelo wabo, umnikelo womlilo kuJehova, nomnikelo wabo wesono phambi kukaJehova ngenxa yokungazi kwabo.
Ibandla lonke labantwana bakwa-Israyeli liyakuthethelelwa, nomfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwabo; ebona ukuthi bonke abantu basekungazini.
Uma umuntu ona ngokungazi, uyakunikela ngethokazi elinomnyaka munye, libe ngumnikelo wesono.
Umpristi uyakuwenzela umphefumulo owona ngokungazi ukubuyisana, uma wona ngokungazi phambi kukaJehova ukumenzele ukubuyisana; njalo uzathethelelwa.
Niyakuba nomthetho munye ngowonile engazi, kozelwe phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, nakomfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwabo.
Kodwa umphefumulo owenza ngokugabadela, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungowokuzalwa ezweni noma ungowemzini, othuka uJehova; lowo muntu uyakunqunywa kubantu bakubo.
Ngokuba udelele izwi leNkosi, wephula umyalo wayo, lowo muntu uyakushaywa ngesiqalekiso sokuxoshwa; ububi bakhe buyakuba phezu kwakhe.
Kwathi abantwana bakwa-Israyeli besehlane bafumana umuntu etheza izinkuni ngosuku lwesabatha.
Abamfumana etheza izinkuni bamyisa kuMose naku-Aroni nakuyo yonke inhlangano.
Basebemfaka esitokisini, ngoba bekungakamemezelwa okuzakwenziwa ngaye.
Khona-ke uJehova wathi kuMose: “Lowo muntu kumelwe abulawe nokubulawa; inhlangano yonke iyakumkhanda ngamatshe ngaphandle kwekamu.
Ibandla lonke lamkhiphela ngaphandle kwekamu, lamkhanda ngamatshe, wafa; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Khuluma nabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, ubatshele ukuthi bazenzele imiphetho emiphethweni yezingubo zabo ezizukulwaneni zabo, futhi kumelwe bafake ibhande eliyibubende emphethweni wemiphetho.
Kuyakuba kini njengensephe, ukuze niyibone, nikhumbule yonke imiyalo yeNkosi, niyenze; futhi ungazifuneli eyakho inhliziyo namehlo akho owafeba ngemva kwawo.
Ukuze nikhumbule futhi niyenze yonke imiyalo yami futhi nibe ngcwele kuNkulunkulu wenu.
NginguJehova uNkulunkulu wenu owanikhipha ezweni laseGibhithe ukuze ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu; nginguJehova uNkulunkulu wenu.
